description: This file implements the ModemService class and related command handling logic for a modem simulator component within the Android Open Source Project. It manages command parsing, handling, and communication with remote clients.

classes.name: CommandHandler
classes.description: Handles command matching and execution for modem commands, supporting full and partial match modes.

classes.name: ModemService
classes.description: Provides services for handling modem commands, managing remote connections, and sending unsolicited commands within the modem simulator.

methods.name: CommandHandler::Compare
methods.description: Compares a given command string with the command prefix, considering match mode.

methods.name: CommandHandler::HandleCommand
methods.description: Executes the appropriate command handler based on match mode.

methods.name: ModemService::HandleModemCommand
methods.description: Iterates through command handlers to find and execute a matching command.

methods.name: ModemService::HandleCommandDefaultSupported
methods.description: Sends a default 'OK' response to the client.

methods.name: ModemService::SendUnsolicitedCommand
methods.description: Sends an unsolicited command to the channel monitor.

methods.name: ModemService::ConnectToRemoteCvd
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to a remote CVD instance.

methods.name: ModemService::SendCommandToRemote
methods.description: Sends a command to a remote client via the channel monitor.

methods.name: ModemService::CloseRemoteConnection
methods.description: Closes a remote client connection via the channel monitor.

methods.name: ModemService::GetHostId
methods.description: Retrieves the host ID from device configuration.
